title: turnera melochioides var. genuina
intro: Turnera melochioides var. genuina, commonly known as Damiana, is a plant species native to the Americas that belongs to the Turneraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including relief from anxiety, insomnia, and menopausal symptoms, as well as its ability to boost libido and energy. The therapeutic actions of Damiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of Damiana may also contribute to its ability to modulate the nervous system, reduce stress, and improve mood.
